panels.title: SNMP collection
panels.description: Collection status only, not NAS health. Unknown when telemetry is missing or older than 180 seconds.

targets.expr: (up{job="qnap",instance="$nas"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="qnap",instance="$nas"}) < 180)) or on() vector(-1)

((sysUptime{job="qnap",instance="$nas"} and (time() - timestamp(sysUptime{job="qnap",instance="$nas"}) < 180))) and on(job, instance) ((up{job="qnap",instance="$nas"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="qnap",instance="$nas"}) < 180)) == 1)

((systemCPU_Usage{job="qnap",instance="$nas"} and (time() - timestamp(systemCPU_Usage{job="qnap",instance="$nas"}) < 180))) and on(job, instance) ((up{job="qnap",instance="$nas"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="qnap",instance="$nas"}) < 180)) == 1)

panels.title: Memory in use
panels.description: 100 × (1 − available / total). Includes only memory unavailable for new workloads; no byte-unit assumption.

targets.expr: (100 * (1 - (systemAvailableMem{job="qnap",instance="$nas"} and (time() - timestamp(systemAvailableMem{job="qnap",instance="$nas"}) < 180)) / ((systemTotalMem{job="qnap",instance="$nas"} and (time() - timestamp(systemTotalMem{job="qnap",instance="$nas"}) < 180)) > 0))) and on(job, instance) ((up{job="qnap",instance="$nas"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="qnap",instance="$nas"}) < 180)) == 1)

panels.title: Pool used capacity
panels.description: Pool capacity minus free space reported by QuTS hero. Do not sum share usage to derive this value.

targets.expr: ((storagepoolCapacity{job="qnap",instance="$nas"} and (time() - timestamp(storagepoolCapacity{job="qnap",instance="$nas"}) < 180)) - (storagepoolFreeSize{job="qnap",instance="$nas"} and (time() - timestamp(storagepoolFreeSize{job="qnap",instance="$nas"}) < 180))) and on(job, instance) ((up{job="qnap",instance="$nas"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="qnap",instance="$nas"}) < 180)) == 1)

(100 * ((storagepoolCapacity{job="qnap",instance="$nas"} and (time() - timestamp(storagepoolCapacity{job="qnap",instance="$nas"}) < 180)) - (storagepoolFreeSize{job="qnap",instance="$nas"} and (time() - timestamp(storagepoolFreeSize{job="qnap",instance="$nas"}) < 180))) / ((storagepoolCapacity{job="qnap",instance="$nas"} and (time() - timestamp(storagepoolCapacity{job="qnap",instance="$nas"}) < 180)) > 0)) and on(job, instance) ((up{job="qnap",instance="$nas"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="qnap",instance="$nas"}) < 180)) == 1)

((storagepoolCapacity{job="qnap",instance="$nas"} and (time() - timestamp(storagepoolCapacity{job="qnap",instance="$nas"}) < 180))) and on(job, instance) ((up{job="qnap",instance="$nas"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="qnap",instance="$nas"}) < 180)) == 1)

((storagepoolFreeSize{job="qnap",instance="$nas"} and (time() - timestamp(storagepoolFreeSize{job="qnap",instance="$nas"}) < 180))) and on(job, instance) ((up{job="qnap",instance="$nas"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="qnap",instance="$nas"}) < 180)) == 1)

panels.title: Pool state
panels.description: QuTS hero state codes from NAS.mib; unknown codes remain numeric and are not treated as Ready.

targets.expr: ((storagepoolStatus{job="qnap",instance="$nas"} and (time() - timestamp(storagepoolStatus{job="qnap",instance="$nas"}) < 180))) and on(job, instance) ((up{job="qnap",instance="$nas"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="qnap",instance="$nas"}) < 180)) == 1)

panels.title: Shared-folder used capacity
panels.description: Logical shared-folder capacity minus free space. Allocation, snapshots, and compression can differ from pool accounting.

panels.title: Disk temperature

panels.title: Memory breakdown
panels.description: Each line is a percentage of total memory. Used, available, free, cache, and buffers are separate NAS-reported counters. These values overlap; do not add or stack them. The MIB does not identify cache as ZFS ARC, so ARC is not inferred from these counters. Missing, failed, or stale telemetry appears as gaps.

targets.expr: (100 * (systemUsedMemory{job="qnap",instance="$nas"} and (time() - timestamp(systemUsedMemory{job="qnap",instance="$nas"}) < 180)) / ((systemTotalMem{job="qnap",instance="$nas"} and (time() - timestamp(systemTotalMem{job="qnap",instance="$nas"}) < 180)) > 0)) and on(job, instance) ((up{job="qnap",instance="$nas"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="qnap",instance="$nas"}) < 180)) == 1)

(100 * (systemAvailableMem{job="qnap",instance="$nas"} and (time() - timestamp(systemAvailableMem{job="qnap",instance="$nas"}) < 180)) / ((systemTotalMem{job="qnap",instance="$nas"} and (time() - timestamp(systemTotalMem{job="qnap",instance="$nas"}) < 180)) > 0)) and on(job, instance) ((up{job="qnap",instance="$nas"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="qnap",instance="$nas"}) < 180)) == 1)

(100 * (systemFreeMem{job="qnap",instance="$nas"} and (time() - timestamp(systemFreeMem{job="qnap",instance="$nas"}) < 180)) / ((systemTotalMem{job="qnap",instance="$nas"} and (time() - timestamp(systemTotalMem{job="qnap",instance="$nas"}) < 180)) > 0)) and on(job, instance) ((up{job="qnap",instance="$nas"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="qnap",instance="$nas"}) < 180)) == 1)

(100 * (systemCacheMemory{job="qnap",instance="$nas"} and (time() - timestamp(systemCacheMemory{job="qnap",instance="$nas"}) < 180)) / ((systemTotalMem{job="qnap",instance="$nas"} and (time() - timestamp(systemTotalMem{job="qnap",instance="$nas"}) < 180)) > 0)) and on(job, instance) ((up{job="qnap",instance="$nas"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="qnap",instance="$nas"}) < 180)) == 1)

(100 * (systemBufferMemory{job="qnap",instance="$nas"} and (time() - timestamp(systemBufferMemory{job="qnap",instance="$nas"}) < 180)) / ((systemTotalMem{job="qnap",instance="$nas"} and (time() - timestamp(systemTotalMem{job="qnap",instance="$nas"}) < 180)) > 0)) and on(job, instance) ((up{job="qnap",instance="$nas"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="qnap",instance="$nas"}) < 180)) == 1)

panels.title: CPU breakdown
panels.description: Overall utilization is the NAS-reported value. Each processor line is its approximately one-minute non-idle percentage from HOST-RESOURCES-MIB. Processor labels are SNMP device indexes, not physical-core or operating-system CPU numbers. The two sources may use different averaging windows. Missing, failed, or stale telemetry appears as gaps. User/system/I/O-wait counters and load averages were not returned by the SNMP probe.

targets.expr: ((systemCPU_Usage{job="qnap",instance="$nas"} and (time() - timestamp(systemCPU_Usage{job="qnap",instance="$nas"}) < 180))) and on(job, instance) ((up{job="qnap",instance="$nas"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="qnap",instance="$nas"}) < 180)) == 1)

((hrProcessorLoad{job="qnap",instance="$nas"} and (time() - timestamp(hrProcessorLoad{job="qnap",instance="$nas"}) < 180))) and on(job, instance) ((up{job="qnap",instance="$nas"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="qnap",instance="$nas"}) < 180)) == 1)

panels.title: Network receive
panels.description: Five-minute average bits per second from 64-bit interface byte counters. Shows Ethernet ports, bonds, and their VLANs individually. Do not sum these lines: traffic can appear on both a bond and its member ports or VLANs. Loopback and virtual bridges are excluded. Requires at least two samples; failed or stale collection appears as gaps.

targets.expr: ((8 * rate(ifHCInOctets{job="qnap",instance="$nas",ifName=~"(eth|bond)[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?"}[5m])) and (ifHCInOctets{job="qnap",instance="$nas"} and (time() - timestamp(ifHCInOctets{job="qnap",instance="$nas"}) < 180))) and on(job, instance) ((up{job="qnap",instance="$nas"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="qnap",instance="$nas"}) < 180)) == 1)

panels.title: Network transmit
panels.description: Five-minute average bits per second from 64-bit interface byte counters. Shows Ethernet ports, bonds, and their VLANs individually. Do not sum these lines: traffic can appear on both a bond and its member ports or VLANs. Loopback and virtual bridges are excluded. Requires at least two samples; failed or stale collection appears as gaps.

targets.expr: ((8 * rate(ifHCOutOctets{job="qnap",instance="$nas",ifName=~"(eth|bond)[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?"}[5m])) and (ifHCOutOctets{job="qnap",instance="$nas"} and (time() - timestamp(ifHCOutOctets{job="qnap",instance="$nas"}) < 180))) and on(job, instance) ((up{job="qnap",instance="$nas"} and (time() - timestamp(up{job="qnap",instance="$nas"}) < 180)) == 1)
